assumptions: the supplied Wisdom (Perception) modifier is already derived correctly
checked_scope: refusal of the non-SRD plus-or-minus-five convention

citations.section: SRD 5.2.1 p.22 'Playing the Game > Proficiency > Passive Perception'

why: Passive Perception = 10 + the Wisdom (Perception) check modifier — supply perception_modifier to resolve the number. Legal only within this checked scope.
